items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: We, Tom Albert, we played string band.

ctx.x: So he had a string band and he played in the Eureka too, huh? Yeah.

We, Tom Albert, we played string band. He used to bring his own whiskey. He didn't wait for the people to give him whiskey. Because sometimes we played plays with the Annali liquor. Tom would get his bottle and go by the band and drink it.
You played with his string band you say? I played with his string band. And who was in the band with him?
